title: Welcome address - Fourth Women in Central Banking Workshop
body:
Welcome address by Ms Victoria Rodríguez Ceja, Governor of Bank of Mexico, at the Fourth Women in Central Banking Workshop, organised by Bank of Mexico, the Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas, Norges Bank (Central Bank of Norway) and Bank of Italy, Mexico City, 6 November 2026.

Source URL: https://www.bis.org/speeches/20261110-welcome-address-fourth-women-central-banking-workshop

title: AI adoption in Europe
body:
Keynote speech by Philip R Lane, Member of the Executive Board of the European Central Bank, at the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco Economic Research Symposium on “AI and the economy”, San Francisco, 30 October 2026.

Source URL: https://www.bis.org/speeches/20261102-ai-adoption-europe
